status: Read-only static analysis of current source while full build is live. This does not confirm build success.
method: Dependency graph over local mathematical modules only; all ordinary imports parsed from source, edges importer->prerequisite. A rebuild scenario uses the seed plus its transitive local consumers, and longest dependency path within that induced subgraph. Standard/external prerequisites are treated as cached and omitted from path counts. Neither job sums nor graph lengths are wall time.
